question: In the Box-Behnken design for dye decolorization by the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith, which run gave the lowest decolorization efficiency, and under what conditions?
rendered:
Document title: Visible-light decolorization of reactive dye by a recoverable Cu2O–Ag@ACR/LF-3D monolith constructed through acrylic-assisted immobilization of Cu2O–Ag-containing domains on a three-dimensional loofah scaffold

The lowest decolorization efficiency was obtained in run 11 of the Box-Behnken design, which was 48.73%. The conditions for this run were:

- pH (A) = 6.5
- Initial dye concentration (B) = 70 mg L^−1
- Monolith dosage (C) = 0.70 g
